before_you_upload: The category target has no id: copy the id for 'Pet Supplies > Dogs > Feeding & Watering Supplies > Bowls' from the console's category targeting search into the two Category rows, or delete the Category ad group's rows.
Download a fresh bulk sheet template from Bulk operations and check the column headers and value spellings match it; use the template's own spellings where they differ.
SKU BC-SFB-L must match the seller SKU in Seller Central exactly, and the offer must be live with stock before 2026-11-03.
Campaigns start enabled on the start date. Set State to paused on the Campaign rows if you want to look them over in the console first.

review_schedule.what: First search term review. Any target or search term with 16 or more clicks and no order: negative exact (search term) or lower the bid by a third (target). Any term from auto, phrase or broad with 2 or more orders at or under the 50% cap: add it to the exact campaign and as a negative exact where it came from.
Rebid from the product's own advertised conversion rate instead of the catalog median, and set placement adjustments from the placement report.

Phase 2: add Sponsored Display (views remarketing of this product's detail page, and contextual targeting of the two competitor ASINs) once the listing has its first ratings and steady detail-page traffic.
Launch ends. Working ACOS moves from 50% to 25%: every bid drops to its after-launch bid in the bid table (or lower, if the product's real conversion rate is below 13.0%).
